what's a good name for a golden retriever?
Sunny, Maple or Biscuit would suit a golden retriever.

Most golden retrievers need about an hour of exercise a day, split into two or more walks.
what should it eat?
A complete large-breed dog food, measured to its weight and activity, with fresh water always out.
how do I stop it pulling on the lead?
Stop each time it pulls and go on only when the lead is slack; reward it for walking at your side.
is it ok to leave it alone at work?
A few hours is fine for an adult dog; for a full day, a walker or a midday visit helps.
what about grooming?
Brush it two or three times a week, and daily when it sheds in spring and autumn.
when should it see a vet?
Once a year for a check-up and vaccines, and at once for limping, vomiting or not eating.
any good toys?
A rope toy, a rubber chew it cannot break and a ball are a good start.
